name: Cheech & Chong - 1g Cart - Blue Venom (H)
description:
Sweet berry flavor with a legendary name behind it. The Cheech & Chong Blue Venom cartridge holds 1 gram of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery. Simple, reliable, and made to last.

Blue Venom brings a bold, berry-forward profile: sweet, juicy blueberry up front with soft floral notes and a smooth, subtly earthy finish. Blended with a hybrid terpene profile for a balanced, easygoing feel — mellow enough to unwind with, bright enough to keep the good times rolling.

Why you'll love it:

1G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Blue Venom flavor — sweet blueberry with soft floral and earthy notes
Hybrid terpene blend — balanced and easygoing, great any time of day
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Big flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Cheech & Chong Blue Venom is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
